id.description: Unique id, used in URLs (?scene=id) and tools.

cast.description: Actors on stage when the scene starts.

tracks.description: One track per actor (key = actor id): steps that run one after the other.

camera.description: Camera cues, each starting at a time or when a marker is reached. Default: a wide shot of everyone.

loop.description: Start over when the scene ends.

Scene.description: A scene: who is on stage, what each actor does (one track each) and where the camera looks.

actor.description: Id used by the tracks, camera cues and targets (e.g. "squid").

at.description: Starting position on the ground: [x, z]. +x is the stage's left side seen from the front camera; +z comes toward the camera.

facing.description: Starting heading: degrees (0 = toward the camera, 90 = toward +x) or another actor's id to face.

Point.description: A point on the ground: [x, z].

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

WalkToStep.description: Walks to a point; walking to an actor stops a little in front of them.

Target.description: Another actor's id, or a point on the ground.

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

TurnToStep.description: Turns in place toward a point or an actor, or to a heading in degrees.

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

LookAtStep.description: Turns the head toward a point or an actor and keeps looking; null looks ahead again.

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

GestureStep.description: Plays an arm gesture (thumbsUp, wave, armUp, shrug…) and waits for it to end.

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

FaceStep.description: Sets a facial expression (neutral, smile, talk, sad, surprise…); with `for`, holds it that many seconds and returns to neutral.

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

ActStep.description: Switches the body mode; with `for`, keeps it that many seconds and returns to idle.

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

WaitStep.description: Waits a number of seconds, or until a marker is reached (with both: whichever comes first).

async.description: Start the step and go on to the next one right away (it keeps running alongside).

mark.description: Marker reached when this step finishes (for `wait.until` and camera `after`).

MarkStep.description: Reaches a marker right away. Every track also reaches "<actor>:end" when it finishes.

t.description: Start time in seconds (use this or `after`).

after.description: Start when this marker is reached.

on.description: Who to frame: one actor id or several. Default: everyone.

from.description: Camera direction: front, side, 3q, back or degrees. With one actor it's relative to where they face; otherwise to the stage.

ease.description: Seconds to glide from the previous shot (0 = cut). Default 1.2.

follow.description: Keep framing the actors as they move.

ShotSize.description: How much the shot shows. overShoulder needs two actors in `on`: [from, toward].
